title: Economic resources, sporting efficiency and uncertainty: a stochastic optimization model of football performance in Africa
summary: We propose a stochastic optimization framework in which football performance is modeled as the result of an efficiency-driven production process under uncertainty. The model incorporates economic inputs, a latent efficiency variable evolving according to a stochastic differential equation, and a control variable representing investment in sports development.
